messages.author: f4491d27aeb3d644
messages.subject: Joint marginals not working
parts:
My inla version is [Package INLA version 22.05.07 Index]
And I tried to run the following sample code and it failed. What are the possible solutions?
n = 100
x = rnorm(n, mean = 1, sd = 0.3)
xx = rnorm(n, mean = -2, sd = 0.3)

y = rpois(n, lambda = exp(x + xx))
selection = list(Predictor = 3:4, x = 1, xx = 1)
rs = inla(y ~ 1 + x + xx,
          data = data.frame(y, x, xx),
          family = "poisson",
          control.predictor = list(compute = TRUE),
          selection = selection)

Best,
Muxing
